tables.name: tw
tables.columns: k UInt64, u0 UInt64, u1 UInt64, u2 UInt64, u3 UInt64

inserts.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number + {i} * {rows} AS k, sipHash64(k, {seed}) AS u0, u0 % 1000 AS u1, k * 7 AS u2, intDiv(k, 3) AS u3 FROM numbers({rows})

statements.sql: ALTER TABLE {db}.tw UPDATE u1 = u1 + 1 WHERE 1
